name: ECO-HACK
description: A 12-hour innovation challenge where teams conceptualise, develop and present technology-driven solutions for real-world environmental and societal challenges.
focus: Building technology-driven solutions for real-world environmental and societal problems.

name: GREEN IDEATHON
description: A sustainability-focused ideation platform for young minds to identify challenges and present practical, impactful ideas for a greener future.
focus: Encouraging young innovators to develop practical ideas for a sustainable future.

name: WAR FOR SURVIVAL
description: An experiential challenge in environmental awareness, resource management and survival preparedness through strategic problem-solving and scenario-based activities.
focus: Testing participants' ability to adapt, strategise and make decisions under challenging environmental conditions.

name: STRUCTURA
description: An engineering and design challenge for sustainable architecture and disaster-resilient infrastructure, from earthquake-resistant structures to flood-resilient designs.
focus: Designing sustainable and disaster-resistant infrastructure using engineering principles.
